entries.description: An SMTP session (ИнтернетПочта). Logon(profile) connects to SMTPServerAddress on SMTPPort (25 when left out), says EHLO, and AUTH LOGIN when SMTPUser is set. SMTPUseSSL is refused: this session speaks plain SMTP. Send(message) delivers one InternetMailMessage: From.Address is the sender, each To entry is a recipient, Subject and Texts are the letter. Logoff says QUIT. A send before logon is refused.
